propositions: The step-budget repetition diagnostic is computed by interpret_failure via usage_log.failure_usage but discarded before reaching gate_error_v1 emission or operator message

The caught exception diagnostic is not propagated to failure_diagnostic in CompletionAgentStep recovery, so raise_completion_workflow_failure never emits the gate_error_v1 sidecar with repetition counters

The _bounded_diagnostic allowlist strips repetition keys (tool_calls_distinct, max_consecutive_repeat, top_repeated_tool_calls, distinct_ratio_window) and its scalar-only merge guard rejects list-valued top_repeated_tool_calls

Operators cannot distinguish budget exhaustion from infinite loops without reading logs because the repetition summary (distinct vs total tool calls) is not rendered in the operator-facing close-gate failure message

The fix must widen _bounded_diagnostic to pass repetition keys through recovery and primary-exception merges, re-prefix them aggregate_ on merge, and render the aggregate_-stripped projection via format_repetition in the failure message
